title: Turtle dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow / stage glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#2a4d69' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='80' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#7ec850' transform='rotate(-20 36 80)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='80' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#7ec850' transform='rotate(20 64 80)'/>

  <!-- front legs / arms raised in dance -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='48' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#8ee86a' transform='rotate(-40 22 48)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='48' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#8ee86a' transform='rotate(40 78 48)'/>

  <!-- little dance feet -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='84' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#5fa832'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='84' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#5fa832'/>

  <!-- shell body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#4a9e2f'/>
  <!-- shell pattern -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#67c440'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#8ee86a'/>
  <!-- shell hex markings -->
  <path d='M50 45 L56 52 L53 60 L47 60 L44 52 Z' fill='#3d8526' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M38 58 L44 55 L47 62 L42 68 L36 64 Z' fill='#3d8526' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M62 58 L56 55 L53 62 L58 68 L64 64 Z' fill='#3d8526' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#8ee86a'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#a8f080'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='30' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#1a3a0a'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='30' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#1a3a0a'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='28.5' r='1.5' fill='#d4ffb0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='28.5' r='1.5' fill='#d4ffb0'/>

  <!-- happy smile -->
  <path d='M44 37 Q50 43 56 37' stroke='#1a3a0a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='36' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f7a8c0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='36' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f7a8c0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M76 60 L84 56 L80 64 Z' fill='#5fa832'/>

  <!-- dance motion lines -->
  <path d='M15 40 Q12 34 16 30' stroke='#f7d060' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M85 40 Q88 34 84 30' stroke='#f7d060' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 20 Q25 15 30 12' stroke='#f7d060' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 20 Q75 15 70 12' stroke='#f7d060' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- musical notes -->
  <g fill='#f7d060'>
    <ellipse cx='20' cy='22' rx='3' ry='2.5' transform='rotate(-20 20 22)'/>
    <rect x='22' y='10' width='1.5' height='12' fill='#f7d060'/>
    <ellipse cx='80' cy='18' rx='3' ry='2.5' transform='rotate(-20 80 18)'/>
    <rect x='82' y='6' width='1.5' height='12' fill='#f7d060'/>
  </g>
</svg>
